subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Decadence
solution:
The correct answer is: **Decline**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"decadence"** refers to a state of moral or cultural decline characterized by excessive indulgence in pleasure or luxury. (पतन)

 
 
• **Example:** The decadence of the Roman Empire is often cited as a reason for its fall.
 
 
 
• **"Decline"** means a gradual and continuous loss of strength, numbers, quality, or value. (अवनति)
 
 
• **Example:** The decline of traditional industries has led to economic hardship in many areas.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that "decline" is a synonym of "decadence".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Decline**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Liberate** (मुक्त करना): To set someone free from a situation, especially imprisonment or slavery.

 
 
• **Example:** The soldiers were sent to liberate the hostages from the terrorists.
 
 
 
• **Dispirited** (निराश): Having lost enthusiasm and hope; disheartened.
 
 
• **Example:** The team felt dispirited after their defeat in the finals.
 
 
 
• **Flowering** (खिलना): The process of developing fully and producing flowers.
 
 
• **Example:** The flowering of the cherry blossoms attracts many tourists each year.
